rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0001
rows.name:
You're saying revenge is foolish
and I should stop, right?
I know that better than anyone.

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I spent a year finding my sister's
killer, only to find him withered like
an old vegetable...

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But I can't just leave my raised fist
hanging like this.

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Call it foolish or whatever,
but I need something to head
toward.

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I need this fool's help for that.
So first, we're going to start
by improving his lifestyle.

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0006
rows.name:
He's taken this awful self-sacrifice
too far and lives a shabby, lazy life.
Just looking at him irritates me!

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0007
rows.name:
First I'll stop him from picking at
food fit for an Alma! A healthy soul
needs a healthy body!

rows.label: tlk70000031_05_msg0008
rows.name:
If my sister were alive today,
I think that's what she
would want.
